content.test_md_blob:
# Click inside the security modal body without closing it

> Prove clicking inside the modal body does not dismiss the open security modal.

## Step 1

Open {{dashboard_url}} and wait until the dashboard page with the Top Holdings card is fully visible.

## Step 2

In the Top Holdings card, explicitly activate the NVDA ticker, open its security preview popover, and activate OPEN SECURITY so the security modal is visible.

## Step 3

Capture baseline: the security modal is open on the dashboard.

## Step 4

Click within the content area of the open security modal body without targeting the close button or the backdrop.

## Step 5

Assert that the security modal remains visible and interactive after the in-body click.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-61, ac-66

Confirm 'security modal closure caused by a click inside the modal body' does NOT appear (forbidden-presence) — the stated promise: Clicking inside the security modal body does not close the modal.
